pagerbot: [PAGER] severity=high rule=inference.gateway.5xx_rate threshold=20% window=5m
pagerbot: region=us-west1 service=inference-gateway-prod current=28.7% baseline=1.2% count=482

pagerbot: details: https://pager.example/incidents/INC-4782 | runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx

oncall-tim: acked. I'm taking it. :point_up:
sre-jen: thanks — i'm hopping in. any obvious deploys?
raj: no deploys in last 30m according to deploybot.
engops-bot: deploybot: no completed deploys in the last 60m to inference-gateway-prod.
maria: seeing lots of 502/504 in the loadbalancer logs pointing at gateway workers timing out.
jules: can you paste a sample of the backend error?
maria: ```
[2026-03-14T02:17:03Z] upstream "model-router-1" timeout after 30000ms status=504 req_id=abc123 
[2026-03-14T02:17:04Z] 502 bad gateway from model-alloc-7: connection reset by peer
```
support-liz: getting a couple customer pings — some apps report "service unavailable" errors. not widespread yet but a few high-traffic accounts.
oncall-tim: quick checklist: 1) confirm attack vs capacity 2) failover region 3) scale pool 4) rollback recent model pins if any.
raj: telemetry shows a sudden spike in tail latency for model-router tasks starting ~02:10Z. CPU usage on model-router-1 is normal, but GPU memory pressure on model-alloc nodes is high.
sre-jen: could be OOMs on quantized kernels — looking at node logs.
maria: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep model-alloc` — several pods in CrashLoopBackOff.
raj: grabbing a pod log: ```
E tensorflow: failed to allocate GPU memory: OutOfMemoryError 
Traceback ... allocate 1.2GB ...
```
jules: that matches. memory blowups on a new quantized build rolled out 4 hours ago?
sre-jen: iirc there was a model runtime tweak on that cadence. tagging eng@runtime.
engops-bot: paging eng-runtime oncall: @eng-runtime oncall — possible runtime regression causing OOMs in inference allocations.
eng-runtime-oncall: acknowledged. jumping in — are we able to route traffic away?
oncall-tim: yes — proposing immediate partial failover: shift 40% traffic to eu-west1 and spin up extra pool in us-east1 for buffer.
maria: updating routing policy now — running `curl -X POST https://controlplane/internal/route -d '{"route_shift": 0.4, "target": "eu-west1"}'`
engops-bot: controlplane: route change accepted. new split 60/40 us-west1->eu-west1.
support-liz: FYI i messaged the three affected customers in the queue with the initial note.
raj: spinning up extra model-alloc nodes in us-east1: `terraform apply -var="pool_size=+6"` — will take ~3-4m to provision.
eng-runtime-oncall: while resources come up, we should kill the problematic runtime pod to prevent OOM thrash and force restart with older image. which pods are bad?
maria: `model-alloc-7` and `model-alloc-9`. old image tag `runtime:v2026-03-13-a` seems stable.
sre-jen: rolling restart on those two to the previous image: `kubectl set image deploy/model-alloc model-alloc=registry/runtime:v2026-03-13-a -n inference`
oncall-tim: doing the restart now. :white_check_mark:
(5m pause)
engops-bot: deploy: rollout of registry/runtime:v2026-03-13-a to model-alloc completed.
maria: pods back to Running. 5xx rate dropping from 28.7% -> 6.4% in last 3m.
raj: tail latency normalizing. counts for 5xx down by ~80%.
support-liz: customers report errors cleared. two accounts confirmed restored, one still seeing intermittent 504s but lower volume.
oncall-tim: good. plan: keep traffic split for 30m, monitor. open a follow-up issue for runtime regression (ENG-RUNTIME-512) and tag for postmortem.
jules: adding canary/automated memory checks to runtime CI — we should catch allocation regressions before rollouts.
sre-jen: agree. also adding an alert for OOM errors aggregated per image-tag to detect regressions.
eng-runtime-oncall: i'll roll the suspected build back from canary pipeline and start a root-cause investigation. thanks for the fast acking.
maria: cost note — expected extra provisioning ~+6 nodes for 15m, roughly $220 for the burst. logging that in the incident ticket.
support-liz: updating customers with resolution note.
oncall-tim: marking incident as mitigated. keeping channel open for a bit for FR/cleanup. :v:
pagerbot: incident INC-4782 status=mitigated responders=[oncall-tim,sre-jen,eng-runtime-oncall,raj,maria,jules,support-liz]

sre-jen: follow up items: 1) postmortem (assigned jules) 2) add image-tag OOM alert (assigned raj) 3) runtime CI memory test (assigned eng-runtime team) 4) update rollback playbook (assigned tim)
jules: will own the postmortem. creating ENG-INC-4782-POSTMORTEM and linking runbook.
eng-runtime-oncall: will report root cause by EOD.
support-liz: i'll paste customer messages to the incident ticket for SRE/Customer Success context.
oncall-tim: thanks everyone. closing on-call shift in 10m and will hand to night-sre if anything flares.
